Fraudulent Employment Offers

Beware of employment engagement and phishing campaigns using fraudulent domains. Scammers impersonate Apono employees via email or chat, sending fake offer letters in exchange for personal information. These communications are not from us, and we have no involvement with them. Legitimate Apono communication comes only from “@apono.io” emails. Our hiring process includes interviews and never requires social security details, payments, or equipment purchases. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact hr@apono.io.
